facts.claim: NO LIMIT! Countdown 2027 runs from 19:00 on 31 December 2026 to 21:00 on 1 January 2027; a Party Pass (¥16,900 incl. tax) is required, with re-entry during the event; the Countdown Moment, with about 5,000 fireworks, runs 23:50–00:05 over the Lagoon; Super Nintendo World closes for maintenance for a time and each guest gets only one area timed-entry or standby ticket, via the official app. General sale opens around 21:00 on 4 November 2026 on the Web Ticket Store, Lawson Ticket and at official hotels (some excluded; for staying guests only), if stock remains.

facts.claim: By the park's estimates, Universal City Station is about 11 minutes from Osaka Station (Umeda) via the direct passage or Nishikujo, about 15 minutes from JR-Namba and about 16 minutes from Shin-Osaka.

USJ lists seven official hotels: Oriental Hotel Universal City (signature breakfast), The Singulari Hotel & Skyspa (directly connected to the station; outdoor bath and sauna), The Park Front Hotel (right outside the main gate, closest to the park), Hotel Kintetsu Universal City (Sesame Street-themed floors; in-hotel Universal Studios Store), Hotel Keihan Universal Tower (natural hot spring with views from the 31st floor; sky restaurant and bar), Hotel Universal Port (Minions in lobby and rooms; in-hotel store) and Hotel Universal Port Vita (opened July 2018; sun and nature designs). OMO7 Osaka and RIHGA Royal Hotel Osaka are listed as partner hotels with a direct shuttle bus.
RIHGA Royal Hotel Osaka runs a free bus for staying guests to Universal Studios Japan: one a day, booked by the previous day, 45 seats, about 25 minutes, departing one hour before the park opens.

facts.claim: Since 1 June 2026 Hakuba Village charges an accommodation tax, collected together with Nagano Prefecture's ¥100 share, of ¥200 per person per night on room-only prices (before consumption tax) of ¥6,000-19,999, ¥400 from ¥20,000, ¥900 from ¥50,000 and ¥1,900 from ¥100,000, until 31 May 2029; from 1 June 2029 it is ¥300, ¥500, ¥1,000 and ¥2,000, the prefecture's share ¥150.

facts.claim: The Hakuba Valley All-Mountain Day Pass for 2026-27, valid at all ten Hakuba Valley resorts, is ¥11,100 for an adult (13+) and ¥6,400 for a child (6-12) for one day, ¥32,200 for an adult for three days (used within six) and ¥53,400 for five (used within ten); it goes on sale around November on the official webshop, includes the valley shuttle on ski days and is not valid for night skiing.
